findings.finding: Already knowing a field value does not itself establish a completing action. The draft rule immediately recommends that action while citing natural N1/N3/N4 cases whose completion criteria remain missing or implementation absent.
findings.recommended_change: Separate skip-the-repeat-question from action sufficiency: do not ask again for already known values; give a common action only if its adequacy is established, otherwise give the supported next step or hold.
findings.would_change: A complete criterion and available implementation for each known-value natural case would justify immediate completing action.
findings.final_resolution: Q8 rule1 now separates skipping a repeated question from a justified common completing action and allows supported next steps/holds.

findings.finding: RUSA users knowing their goal, original NCAT datum belonging to a producer, and OS accuracy being set by user/client mix procedural inputs with unobserved ownership assignments. The documents do not empirically establish exclusive owners or universal prior knowledge.
findings.recommended_change: Label this as documented inputs plus investigator-inferred parties to consult. Say users provide/clarify purpose and prior search; original metadata/producer may identify datum; required accuracy is an input to determine, not proven ownership.
findings.would_change: A procedure explicitly assigning responsibility or observed intake record with that party supplying the value would support stronger ownership wording.
findings.final_resolution: Cross-domain rows now describe documented inputs and possible consultation roles; the following paragraph explicitly labels value ownership as researcher inference, not observed user knowledge.

findings.location: Table2 PAN-N2 three rows, especially B and C-value2/no_answer
findings.finding: Unannotated frozen answers still state that the original request supplies must_retain, that C2 relaxes the original constraint, and that noanswer preserves the known must_retain. These are the precise inferences withdrawn later in Q2. Front-loaded tables can therefore present the withdrawn inference as the current conclusion.
findings.recommended_change: Preserve sealed answer text, but visibly label the affected cells or rows as frozen investigator inference withdrawn after review. State that literal-key obligation and counterfactual conflict are currently unestablished.
findings.would_change: A verified original or explicit later author statement demanding the literal global key could reinstate this predicate; current typography goals alone cannot.
findings.final_resolution: All9 N2 policy cells in Table2 visibly carry bold frozen-inference-withdrawn annotations. Original frozen text is preserved without presenting it as the current conclusion.

findings.location: Table1 and Q1 PAN-N2 purpose sentence
findings.finding: The short purpose still says zh-CN is maintained, which can reintroduce literal-key retention despite the adjacent correction.
findings.recommended_change: Describe avoiding Chinese quotation/font problems while separating western font styling; mark literal global lang retention as unestablished. Keep frozen packet wording intact as historical record.
findings.would_change: Explicit literal-key requirement would permit the stronger description.
findings.final_resolution: Table1 and Q1 N2 purpose now state typography goals and explicitly leave literal global lang retention unestablished.

findings.finding: Pandoc/GDAL fixed-version statement is unqualified although natural cases include other versions and the GDAL-N3 candidate mismatch.
findings.recommended_change: Say constructed-control fixed versions are Pandoc2.11.3.2 and GDAL3.2.1. Per-natural-case versions remain in the tables.
findings.would_change: None needed; this is a scope label, not new evidence.
findings.final_resolution: Q3 now explicitly limits the fixed Pandoc/GDAL versions to constructed controls.

findings.finding: The asserted four-way behavior matches the exact fixture; the sentence can make its evidence type more explicit.
findings.recommended_change: Begin the behavioral statement with in the stored expected outputs. Do not imply this Pandoc test was executed during AF074.
findings.would_change: An exact-version execution receipt could add a separate execution layer, without replacing the stored expectation provenance.
findings.resolution: Root now has8 executed tests matching stored expectations, including all4 empty_paragraphs round trips. Report can add this separate researcher execution layer.
findings.final_resolution: Q7 labels stored expectations and separately reports the newly verified fixed-release execution of all4 round trips.

findings.finding: No user behavior data is broader than the report can claim: Q6 already has two public intentions and one other-field action/resolution report. What is absent is actual use/selection of the researcher A/B/C policies.
findings.recommended_change: After the new Pandoc execution, limit the remaining execution gap specifically to GDAL3.2.1; actual A/B/C user selection and time remain unmeasured. Preserve existing public behavior observations.
findings.would_change: An actual policy recipient observation would add policy selection evidence; the existing other-field report does not.
findings.final_resolution: Final weakness3 now names missing GDAL3.2.1 execution and actual A/B/C selection/time, while preserving Pandoc2.11.3.2 execution and public other-field observations.

remaining_boundaries: Do not use absent human A/B/C experimentation as evidence of zero policy effect. The user excludes a new-person experiment.
Stored expectations and analytic criteria are legitimate evidence layers; absence of historical execution receipts must be reported accurately, not silently replaced by3.10.3.
Natural paired complete-outcome denominator remains0 unless new paired criterion evidence is actually obtained; an opened-event recovery alone is insufficient.
overall: Final report wording and first8 opening concordance pass this bounded independent model review. All8 identified findings were resolved and reread; constructed counts and technical-versus-human limits remain intact. This does not convert research PARTIAL into central DONE or certify forthcoming C07 artifacts.
